title: Does your $65 cake pay for your time?
description: Ingredients are only part of the quote. In this illustrative example, costs including chosen pay total $71.25 at a $65 price. Check your own costs with the free calculator and request the result by email. The complete Excel kit is sold separately.
alt_text: Illustrative cake costing at a $65 selling price: entered costs and chosen pay total $71.25, leaving a $6.25 gap.

title: 25% markup is not 25% margin
description: On $60 of costs, a 25% markup gives a $75 price. A 25% margin requires $80 before additional fees and tax. Use the free cake pricing calculator to check your own inputs. Result by email; Excel workbook sold separately.
alt_text: A $60 cost gives a $75 price with 25% markup, versus $80 for a 25% margin before fees and tax.

title: Five costs to check before quoting a cake
description: Ingredients, working time, packaging, allocated overheads and payment fees belong in the price check. Use your own numbers in the free cake calculator. Request the result by email. Optional paid Excel kit available.
alt_text: Five cake pricing inputs: ingredients, working time, packaging, overheads and payment fees.

title: Cake pricing starts with your working hours
description: Have you counted the work around the cake as well as decorating? Review sourcing, baking, cleaning and order admin. Enter your own time and chosen pay in the free price check. Get the result by email.
alt_text: Cake pricing example: three working hours at a chosen $15 rate add $45 before other costs.

title: A cake box belongs in the quote too
description: Boards, boxes and packaging can be easy to miss when reusing an old quote. Check the inputs behind your next price with the free calculator. Email result available; complete Excel workbook sold separately.
alt_text: Illustration of a cake box with a ribbon and a reminder to include boards, boxes and finishing materials.

title: What does your payment fee do to the cake price?
description: A percentage fee changes with the selling price. Add your real provider fees to your costs before choosing a margin. Try the free cake price check and receive your calculation by email.
alt_text: Example payment fee calculation: 3% of a $65 price plus $0.30 equals $2.25.

title: How much does the recipe actually cost?
description: Use the cost of the amount in the recipe, not the whole pack price. Example: $4 per 1,000 g means 250 g costs $1. Check your full cake costs in the free calculator. Illustrative figures; result by email.
alt_text: Recipe cost example: a $4 pack of 1,000 grams means using 250 grams costs $1.

title: Is the cake price covering your chosen pay?
description: A quote may cover ingredients while leaving too little for the hours you entered. Check ingredients, time, overheads and fees together. The free calculator sends the requested result by email.
alt_text: Example cake costs shown as horizontal bars: ingredients $18, work $45, packaging and overhead $6, payment fee $2.25.

title: Cleaning time is still working time
description: Before the next custom cake quote, review the tasks that belong to that order. Include the hours you expect to work and the pay you choose. Try one free cake price check; result by email.
alt_text: Clock illustration and example costing: 30 minutes at $15 per hour adds $7.50 of chosen pay.

title: Check the margin before sending the cake quote
description: Margin and markup use different denominators. Use your own cake costs to check the price for your chosen margin. Free calculator with email result; paid desktop Excel kit optional.
alt_text: Example margin calculation: $60 cost divided by 0.75 gives an $80 price for 25% margin before fees and tax.

title: From cake costs to a printable customer quote
description: Keep pricing and a printable quote in one Excel workbook. Cake Quote Kit also includes manual ingredient inventory, a shopping list, order tracking and charts. One-time purchase. Desktop Excel required and not included.
alt_text: Actual Cake Quote Kit customer quote preview showing a fictional sample order.

title: An ingredient stock log beside your cake costing
description: Record ingredient stock movements manually in Cake Quote Kit and keep the records alongside the next cake calculation. A paid digital Excel workbook for custom cake makers. Desktop Excel required.
alt_text: Actual ingredient stock excerpt showing on-hand amounts and reorder status; stock movements are recorded manually.

title: One workbook for the next cake enquiry
description: Use sample data to learn the workbook, then replace it with your own cake inputs. Pricing, quote, ingredient records, shopping list, order tracking and charts are included. Paid download; desktop Excel is not included.
alt_text: Actual Cake Quote Kit dashboard and chart previews with sample data.

title: Keep cake orders and payments in view
description: Use the order and payment tracker alongside your cake pricing workflow. Cake Quote Kit is a paid Excel download with a quick-start guide. Review the product details and compatibility before buying.
alt_text: Actual Excel order and payment tracker excerpt with sample orders, plus order status, paid-to-date and unpaid balance labels.

title: Free cake price check or the full Excel kit?
description: Check one cake price for free and request the result by email. Choose the separate paid Excel kit to reuse the workflow with quotes, ingredient records and order tracking. See what is included.
alt_text: Comparison of the free cake price calculator with the separately sold Excel workbook.

title: Check recorded ingredients before making a shopping list
description: Cake Quote Kit brings a shopping list and manual ingredient inventory into the same workbook as your cake costing. Review the actual workflow and quick-start guide. One-time Excel download; Microsoft Excel not included.
alt_text: Actual shopping list excerpt with sample required quantities, shortfalls and buy packs for the current quote.

title: The next cake quote deserves fresh costs
description: Supplier prices and the work behind a design can change. Replace old assumptions with your own current inputs. Try the free cake pricing calculator and get the requested result by email.
alt_text: Three inputs to refresh before quoting: supplier prices, recipe amounts and working hours.

title: Before you send that custom cake quote
description: Check the ingredients, working time, packaging, overheads and payment fees. Then decide whether the calculation fits the design and your market. Use the free cake calculator with an email result.
alt_text: Checklist before sending a cake quote: ingredients, working time, packaging, overheads and payment fees.
